content.text: I located the exact upstream fix (apache/echarts PR #21097, commit `852e9bf`) and verified it against the workspace source.

input.summary: Dark-theme tokens are derived from the light palette by a straight lightness inversion (`l => 1 - l`), which compresses the perceptual gap between adjacent neutral/semantic tokens on a dark background so they read as nearly the same shade. Replace the linear inversion with a gamma-style curve `l => 1 - Math.pow(l, 1.5)` so derived dark tokens keep a stronger, more evenly spread lightness contrast while staying in the same hue family. This is a one-line change in `src/visual/tokens.ts`.
steps: DO NOT touch the `accent` branch at lines 209-213 (`modifyHSL(hex as string, null, s => s * 0.5, l => Math.min(1, 1.3 - l))`), the `theme` branch (line 204) or the `highlight` branch (line 207). The upstream fix (apache/echarts commit 852e9bffc6d2489508d91d32fcaad132f4022b91, PR #21097 `fix(theme): adjust dark mode color lightness algorithm`) changes exactly one line and no other file. I fetched that commit's diff and it is a single hunk on `src/visual/tokens.ts` matching the edit above.

NO new public option is introduced. The requirement is purely an internal derivation-curve change; there is no `*Option` interface, `index.d.ts`, or default-value work. Do not add a `lightness`/`darkModeLightness` option.

NO other file needs editing. `tokens.darkColor` is consumed only by `/workspace/src/theme/dark.ts` (line 22: `const color = tokens.darkColor;`), which reads the token values by name — it needs no change. Verified via grep: the only occurrences of `darkColor` in the repo are `/workspace/src/visual/tokens.ts` (lines 92, 107, 204, 207, 211, 215) and `/workspace/src/theme/dark.ts:22`.

VERIFY behavior after the edit (optional sanity check, no test file exists to update). `modifyHSL` (`/workspace/node_modules/zrender/src/tool/color.ts:507-522`) passes a normalized `l` in [0,1] and clamps the returned value via `parseCssFloat`, so `Math.pow(l, 1.5)` is always real and in range. Expected effect on the neutral ramp (dark-mode lightness, old -> new): neutral05 0.025 -> 0.038, neutral10 0.075 -> 0.110, neutral20 0.173 -> 0.247, neutral30 0.269 -> 0.375, neutral40 0.367 -> 0.496, neutral50 0.463 -> 0.606, neutral60 0.561 -> 0.709, neutral70 0.659 -> 0.801, neutral80 0.755 -> 0.879, neutral90 0.853 -> 0.944; neutral00 (0.0) and neutral99 (1.0) are unchanged endpoints. Foreground/derived tones move further from the dark background, restoring hierarchy.

LINT: `Math.pow` is already used in `src/util/number.ts` and `src/chart/treemap/treemapLayout.ts`, so no rule forbids it. The new line is 88 chars, under the `max-len` limit of 120 configured at `/workspace/.eslintrc-common.yaml:174-176`. Run `npx tsc --noEmit -p /workspace/tsconfig.json` (or the repo's `npm run lint`) if a check is desired.

TESTS: there are NO existing unit tests covering `src/visual/tokens.ts` — I grepped `/workspace/test/ut/spec` (dirs: api, component, data, model, scale, series, util) for `tokens`/`darkColor`/`dark` and found nothing. Upstream added no test either.
